purpose: Bulk broaden the number of people and Scripture events represented by identifiable Wikimedia Commons file leads; do not confuse file counts with distinct paintings or canonical identity.
notes: Source page was opened and individual names/pixels transcribed from category media lists; do not infer artist/museum from file title without file-page and custodian verification.
A few deliberately recorded small file leads are explicit quality holds, not eligible for user-reviewable gallery.

All physical-original identity, rights, faithful painting-only crop, and duplication checks remain pending. Some images are photographs of frescoes or onsite altarpieces; accept only after curatorial QA.
Saint Luke Zurbarán file variants may refer to the same painting; Francis de Sales portrait variants and original museum images likewise require canonical deduplication.
Event discovery keys are research handles only; map to existing Biblical Atlas/1962 Calendar IDs before any reuse.
Preserve historical 277 human scores, low-rated exclusions, artist exclusions Fra Angelico and El Greco, and canonical app content.
